description: The configuration surface of the kube-ovn-subnet chart. GENERATED from values.yaml by `./build.sh Charts` and diffed in CI — docs/plan/03 § charts/. Edit values.yaml, never this file. Members carrying `x-cybercloud-api: false` are chart or platform plumbing and are not part of the resource body.

addressPrefix.description: The range addresses are allocated from.

v4.description: The IPv4 prefix, in CIDR form. ⚠ Host bits are cleared by the fabric, so 10.20.1.7/24 is stored as 10.20.1.0/24 and both name the same network. It may not overlap a range the platform reserves, which is refused with the conflicting range named.

v6.description: The IPv6 prefix, or empty for an IPv4-only subnet. Setting both makes the subnet dual-stack — docs/plan/14 § IPv6.

enableDhcp.description: Whether the fabric answers DHCP in this subnet. Off by default: an address is assigned to a workload's port when the port is created, and DHCP is for guests that insist on asking — a virtual machine rather than a container.

nameOverride.description: Replace the generated object-name stem. Empty means derive it from the release name.
nameOverride.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Helm plumbing. Nothing about it belongs in a resource body.

natOutgoing.description: Whether workloads in this subnet reach the internet through source NAT. Off by default. ⚠ This is the opposite of Kube-OVN's own default for its cluster subnet, deliberately: a tenant subnet that silently egresses is a surprise, and docs/plan/12 § Cross-cutting decisions defaults external exposure to off. It also requires the network's enableExternal to be on; without it the flag is accepted and nothing egresses.
